title: SandpaneCoreRpcRequest
description: Client → Core request frame (newline-delimited JSON over Unix socket / named pipe). Protocol version negotiated via system.probe.

v.description: Protocol version the client speaks. Current: 1.

id.description: Client-chosen correlation id, echoed verbatim in the response.

method.description: Allowlisted dotted method name. There is deliberately no free-form execution method. The set is additive for protocol v1: discovery revision 1 adds conversation.list, conversation.history and task.list; addition A1 adds sandbox.stop and sandbox.remove (two-step server-side confirmation token). Addition A3a adds project.update, project.archive, project.unarchive, project.delete (two-step confirmation token bound to the project id), project.add_repository and project.remove_repository; method segments are lowercase snake_case. Addition A3b adds conversation.rename, conversation.archive, conversation.unarchive, conversation.delete (two-step confirmation token bound to the conversation id) and conversation.export (redacted, paged, bounded; read-only). There is deliberately no sandbox.start: sbx v0.47 has none. A Core advertises exactly what it handles via core-capabilities.methods.

params.description: Method-specific payload object ({} when empty). Validated per method; unknown/invalid shapes → VALIDATION_FAILED.
